thread:
harry: deploy-bot flagged a canary regression on convo-service after v2.0.3. p95 tripled and a few 504s. deploy-bot suggests autorevert to v2.0.1. change window ends 03:30 UTC. asking for manual hold so we can choose lane-level rollback.
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary convo-service p95=1280ms (baseline 420ms), 504s 0.05%->0.9%. recommended revert: v2.0.1. details: https://telemetry.redwood/canary/4890
mina: any idea if this is infra or model pathing? we recently flipped streaming-buffer=true in hosted.
harry: early signs show elevated queue times on hosted canary only; dedicated lanes look fine.
ops: since dedicated customers are mid-migration, recommend a hosted-only rollback and preserve dedicated pins. suppress autorevert for 10m while we act.
product: agree. CS wants a short blurb either way. can we do hosted lane only?
ops: yes: `release rollback --svc convo-service --to v2.0.1 --lane hosted --slice 12 --strategy rolling --reason "canary tail regression; preserve dedicated"`
harry: suppressing autorevert: `deployctl suppress-autorevert --svc convo-service --for 10m`
ops: executing hosted rollback in 1m. pausing hosted canary autoscale: `infractl autoscale set convo-hosted-canary --min 0 --max 0`
deploy-bot: ACTION: hosted rollback initiated by ops. progress: 20% -> 55% -> 100%.
mina: after rollback hosted p95=440ms, 504s back to baseline. dedicated lane remains on v2.0.3 with slightly higher tails but isolated.
product: drafted blurb: "We observed a transient performance regression in a hosted canary and rolled back hosted to the prior stable version. Dedicated customer lanes were preserved. No customer data impacted; RCA to follow." sending to CSMs now.
cs: blurb received and sent to customers with hosted exposure.
legal: filing incident note. no immediate SLA breach expected. include timeline and lane decision.
harry: ops re-enable hosted autoscale: `infractl autoscale set convo-hosted-canary --min 1 --max 8`. monitor for 2h with tightened p95 alert.
ops: autoscale re-enabled, kvcache warming normal. creating RCA ticket and assigning to mina.
mina: I'll own RCA, will compare allocator and streaming-buffer traces between hosted and dedicated. target preliminary findings in 6 hours. closing thread once stable. :white_check_mark:
